scope: Read and verify saved evidence only; do not rerun check.py, geometry, Arb constants, Green kernels, or any previous numeric batch.
finite_checks: Verify the three locked local hashes and all seven external input hashes.
Compare the completed checkpoint byte for byte with saved results when the original checkpoint is present.
Check positive ordered saved dyadic endpoints for all eight constants; compare the saved upper endpoints to the four preregistered rational caps using Fraction only.
Preserve recorded timings and original PID as historical receipt fields, without inferring an original shell exit code.
failure_policy: Stop on the first mismatch; no restart, recalculation, parameter adjustment or replacement of original evidence.
